construct: Pathogenic COL3A1 variants alter type III procollagen, an important structural component of skin, blood vessels, and hollow organs, causing tissue fragility and predisposition to spontaneous arterial or organ rupture.

adversarial_second_pass.independent_reconstruction: Thin translucent skin, easy bruising, familial arterial rupture, and a pathogenic COL3A1 variant identify vascular Ehlers-Danlos syndrome; COL3A1 encodes type III procollagen.
adversarial_second_pass.strongest_distractor_attack: Types I, IV, VII collagen and fibrillin-1 are all real connective-tissue proteins with associated disorders, but the explicit COL3A1 variant uniquely maps to type III collagen.
